content:
cassie: Heads-up — planning deploy of svc-gen 1.2.0 to prod in ~15m. Plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m soak between steps. Feature flag `ff:gen_v2` will be in canary mode (unpin for canary) and then pinned at chosen SHAs for wider rollout. Requesting deploy-bot canary + surge gate to avoid sudden traffic spike.

matt: Copy. I'll kick it off. deploy-bot, start canary for svc-gen with pin=sha:abcd123 and ff=ff:gen_v2=canary — please hold between steps.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for svc-gen@1.2.0 · cohort: 5% · pin: sha:abcd123 · ff:gen_v2=canary. Health checks: smoke, p95 latency, error-rate. Dash: https://monitoring.example.com/d/svc-gen · I'll post updates here.

jamal: Quick guardrails: rollback if error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 2m OR p95 latency > 300ms over 5m. Also watch tokenization/regression RPS for gen_v2 reranks.

sre-rotations: Oncall alerted and thresholds configured. I'll add Pager when error-rate breach hits. Also setting temporary QoS throttle at edge if traffic spikes x2 baseline.

lucy: I'll draft a short release note blurb and post to #release-notes when canary reaches 10%. Draft: "svc-gen v1.2.0 — gen_v2 routing enabled under feature flag ff:gen_v2; rolling canary, controlled ramp. See monitoring link."

cassie: Two operational asks: 1) Do NOT auto-unpin ff:gen_v2 to 100% — manual approval required at 50% stable. 2) Keep version pins in workloadctl so rollback can target previous sha quickly.

matt: Ack. Manual promotion step set. If we need to rollback quickly: `/deploy rollback --service svc-gen --to-sha abcd122 --reason <brief>` — I'll keep that ready.

deploy-bot: Update: canary healthy after 10m · errors=0.08% · p95=210ms · advancing to 10% now.

jamal: 10% looks clear so far. Hold for 20m soak, then if metrics stable start 50% progression. Also put sampling on gen_v2 outputs for eval sets (small prompt sample) to catch quality regressions.

sre-rotations: Shared a quick dashboard snippet for the team: https://monitoring.example.com/d/svc-gen?panelId=5 — alerting rules:
```
- error_rate > 0.5% for 2m -> Page
- p95_latency > 300ms for 5m -> Ops channel
- traffic > 2x baseline -> Auto-throttle (edge)
```

cassie: If we see a traffic surge that trips the throttle, plan = pin ff:gen_v2 back to off-canary and drain cohort, then rollback service if errors persist. Communicate in this thread before manual rollback.

matt: Rolling. Will update on each step. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Progress update: 10% soak done, metrics steady. Ready for manual 50% step. Use `/deploy promote --service svc-gen --to 50% --pin sha:abcd123` when ready.

jamal: I'll validate quality samples and signal go/no-go in 10m.

lucy: Publishing the release note stub now so product knows the rollout plan. Posting to #release-notes shortly.

sre-rotations: Oncall watching. Paging if thresholds hit. GL everyone.

matt: Thanks. If anyone sees anything odd, @matt or @cassie in this thread. :thumbsup:
